item.title: Operational Research
item.description: Comprehensive, step-by-step roadmap to mastering Operational Research (OR) and Optimization, from foundational mathematics to expert-level systems and research.

item.title: AI Roadmap
item.description: Practical AI roadmap outlining architectures, deployment, security, tooling and specialization paths for building production AI systems.

item.title: Gen AI Patterns
item.description: Reusable design patterns and best practices for building robust, efficient and scalable LLM applications, covering retrieval, memory, agents, RAG and orchestration.

item.title: GenAI Tools comparison
item.description: Detailed comparison and analysis of GenAI frameworks, tools and infrastructure to help select the right stack for production and research.

item.title: Natural Language Processing
item.description: Practical overview of NLP concepts, pipelines and tools—covering tokenization, embeddings, model architectures and production best practices.

item.title: Kubernetes
item.description: Overview of Kubernetes architecture, core concepts (pods, nodes, volumes) and practical examples for deployment and storage patterns.

item.title: COBOL Guide
item.description: Practical COBOL reference covering program structure, copybooks, JCL, datasets and migration tips for modern engineers.

item.title: YAML Guide
item.description: Comprehensive YAML reference covering syntax, types, multi-line strings, best practices and common pitfalls for config and DevOps use.

item.title: Mainframe Retirement using Gen-AI
item.description: Step-by-step guide to migrating COBOL mainframe systems to modern Java services using AI-assisted tooling, graph-based analysis and migration best practices.

item.title: Behavioral Interview
item.description: Guide to Amazon leadership principles with behavioral interview questions and structured answer templates to prepare for interviews.

item.title: 23 Core Design Patterns
item.description: Core design patterns are proven solutions to common software engineering problems. They help structure code for flexibility, scalability and maintainability. Mastering these patterns is essential for interviews and for building robust, reusable and understandable software systems.

item.title: Data Structure Algorithms
item.description: Curated list of classic data structure and algorithm problems commonly asked in technical interviews, organized by topic.

item.title: JEE Design Patterns
item.description: JEE design patterns are specialized solutions for enterprise Java applications. They address scalability, maintainability and performance challenges in distributed systems, helping developers build robust, modular and efficient enterprise-grade software.

item.title: Laws and Principles
item.description: A curated reference of scientific, engineering and organizational laws and principles that shape software, systems and team behavior.

item.title: System Design Concepts
item.description: System design is a critical aspect of software engineering that involves creating scalable, reliable and efficient systems.

item.title: Youtube System Design
item.description: The goal is to demonstrate a practical, modern approach to building and scaling a global video platform, suitable for system design interviews.

item.title: Python Quicky
item.description: Concise, interview-focused Python reference covering syntax, data structures, OOP, concurrency and common pitfalls with examples.
